(ns knoxx.backend.extern.openplanner-sdk
  "JS boundary for the OpenPlanner SDK (@open-hax/openplanner-sdk).

   The SDK is OpenPlanner's data plane as a library: direct MongoDB plus
   self-sourced embeddings (EMBED_PROVIDER_*), no REST hop. This adapter owns
   the singleton SDK instance and all interop; callers pass and receive CLJS
   data shaped exactly like the corresponding /v1 REST response bodies."
  (:require ["@open-hax/openplanner-sdk" :as sdk-mod]
            ["@open-hax/openplanner-graph-claim-core" :as graph-core]
            ["@open-hax/openplanner-sdk/mongo-vectors" :as mongo-vectors]
            ["@open-hax/openplanner-sdk/embedding-text" :as embedding-text]
            [knoxx.backend.extern.json :as xjson]))

(defonce ^:private sdk-promise* (atom nil))

(defn- resolve-mongo-uri
  "Resolve the MongoDB connection string from the same env lineage the rest of
   the backend uses (see knoxx.backend.infra.mongo-client)."
  []
  (or (aget js/process.env "MONGODB_URI")
      (aget js/process.env "OPENPLANNER_MONGODB_URI")
      "mongodb://localhost:27017"))

(defn- resolve-mongo-db-name
  []
  (or (aget js/process.env "MONGODB_DB")
      (aget js/process.env "OPENPLANNER_MONGODB_DB")
      "openplanner"))

(defn- create-sdk!
  []
  (sdk-mod/createOpenPlannerSdk
   #js {:config #js {:mongodb #js {:uri (resolve-mongo-uri)
                                   :dbName (resolve-mongo-db-name)}}
        :log #js {:warn (fn [obj msg]
                          (js/console.warn "[openplanner-sdk]" msg
                                           (or (some-> obj (aget "err") (aget "message")) "")))}}))

(defn- get-sdk!
  "Shared SDK instance as a js Promise; created on first use."
  ^js []
  (or @sdk-promise*
      (let [created (create-sdk!)]
        (reset! sdk-promise* created)
        created)))

(defn ^:async scoped-graph-recall!
  "Use the owning validated read-only graph boundary. Resolve host authority
   before opening the SDK and re-resolve through it at each async read stage."
  [request resolve-current-authority!]
  (if (nil? (await (resolve-current-authority!)))
    {:version 1 :field-status "not-loaded"
     :selection {:status "denied" :hits []
                 :feedback {:status "not-requested" :attempted 0 :completed 0}}}
    (let [sdk (await (get-sdk!))
          resolve! (^:async fn [] (clj->js (await (resolve-current-authority!))))
          reader (graph-core/createScopedMongoRecall sdk resolve! embedding-text/formatEmbeddingQueryText)]
      (xjson/to-cljs (await (reader (clj->js request)))))))

(defn valid-scoped-graph-result?
  "Validate decoded port data through the owning graph result contract."
  [result]
  (graph-core/validScopedMongoRecallResult (clj->js result)))

(defn ^:async close-sdk!
  "Close the shared SDK instance (mongo connection). Safe to call when unused."
  []
  (when-let [pending @sdk-promise*]
    (reset! sdk-promise* nil)
    (let [sdk (await pending)]
      (await (.close sdk)))))

(defn- mongo-ctx
  ^js [^js sdk]
  #js {:mongo (.-mongo sdk)})

(defn- configured-embedding-dimensions!
  []
  (let [raw (aget js/process.env "EMBED_PROVIDER_DIMENSIONS")
        trimmed (when (string? raw) (.trim raw))
        parsed (js/Number trimmed)]
    (when-not (and (string? raw)
                   (re-matches #"[1-9][0-9]*" trimmed)
                   (js/Number.isInteger parsed)
                   (pos? parsed))
      (throw (ex-info
              "EMBED_PROVIDER_DIMENSIONS must be configured as a positive integer"
              {:status 503
               :code "openplanner_embedding_dimensions_invalid"
               :configured-value raw})))
    parsed))

(defn- finite-number?
  [value]
  (and (number? value) (js/Number.isFinite value)))

(defn- valid-vector-row?
  [expected-dimensions row]
  (let [embedding (:embedding row)]
    (and (vector? embedding)
         (pos? (count embedding))
         (= expected-dimensions (count embedding))
         (= expected-dimensions (:embedding_dimensions row))
         (every? finite-number? embedding))))

(defn- checked-event-ids!
  [event-ids]
  (let [ids (vec (distinct event-ids))]
    (when-let [invalid-input-ids
               (seq (filterv #(not (and (string? %) (seq (.trim %)))) ids))]
      (throw (ex-info "OpenPlanner vector verification requires event ids"
                      {:status 500
                       :code "openplanner_event_ids_invalid"
                       :invalid-event-ids (vec invalid-input-ids)})))
    ids))

(defn- ^:async hot-vector-rows!
  [^js sdk ids]
  (let [hot-vectors (some-> sdk (.-mongo) (.-hotVectors))]
    (when-not (and hot-vectors (fn? (.-find hot-vectors)))
      (throw (ex-info "OpenPlanner hot-vector collection is unavailable"
                      {:status 503
                       :code "openplanner_hot_vectors_unavailable"
                       :event-ids ids})))
    (let [cursor (.find hot-vectors
                        (clj->js {:parent_id {:$in ids}})
                        (clj->js {:projection {:_id 1
                                               :parent_id 1
                                               :embedding 1
                                               :embedding_dimensions 1}}))]
      (xjson/to-cljs (await (.toArray cursor))))))

(defn- vector-coverage
  [ids expected-dimensions rows]
  (let [rows-by-event (group-by :parent_id rows)
        missing (filterv #(empty? (get rows-by-event %)) ids)
        invalid (filterv (fn [id]
                           (some #(not (valid-vector-row? expected-dimensions %))
                                 (get rows-by-event id)))
                         ids)]
    {:missing-event-ids missing
     :invalid-event-ids invalid}))

(defn- assert-vector-coverage!
  [ids expected-dimensions rows]
  (let [{:keys [missing-event-ids invalid-event-ids]}
        (vector-coverage ids expected-dimensions rows)]
    (when (or (seq missing-event-ids) (seq invalid-event-ids))
      (throw (ex-info
              "OpenPlanner event vector indexing did not materialize the configured embedding shape"
              {:status 503
               :code "openplanner_event_vector_verification_failed"
               :event-ids ids
               :expected-dimensions expected-dimensions
               :missing-event-ids missing-event-ids
               :invalid-event-ids invalid-event-ids})))
    {:ok true
     :event-ids ids
     :event-count (count ids)
     :vector-count (count rows)
     :embedding-dimensions expected-dimensions}))

(defn- ^:async verify-event-vectors-with-sdk!
  [^js sdk event-ids]
  (let [ids (checked-event-ids! event-ids)]
    (if (empty? ids)
      {:ok true :event-ids [] :event-count 0 :vector-count 0}
      (let [expected-dimensions (configured-embedding-dimensions!)
            rows (await (hot-vector-rows! sdk ids))]
        (assert-vector-coverage! ids expected-dimensions rows)))))

(defn ^:async verify-event-vectors!
  "Fail closed unless every named event has materialized hot-vector chunks.

  This is public so an idempotent caller that finds an already-durable base
  event can verify its detached projection too; replay must not equate an
  event row with a usable embedding. Every chunk must carry a finite, nonempty
  vector whose length and recorded dimension equal EMBED_PROVIDER_DIMENSIONS."
  [event-ids]
  (let [sdk (await (get-sdk!))]
    (await (verify-event-vectors-with-sdk! sdk event-ids))))

(defn- events-collection!
  [^js sdk event-id]
  (let [events (some-> sdk (.-mongo) (.-events))]
    (when-not (and events
                   (fn? (.-find events))
                   (fn? (.-findOne events))
                   (fn? (.-updateOne events)))
      (throw (ex-info "OpenPlanner event collection is unavailable"
                      {:status 503
                       :code "openplanner_events_unavailable"
                       :event-id event-id})))
    events))

(defn- ^:async event-row!
  [^js events event-id]
  (xjson/to-cljs
   (await (.findOne events
                    (clj->js {:id event-id})
                    (clj->js {:projection {:id 1 :extra 1}})))))

(defn- extra-state!
  [event-id row required-extra]
  (when-not row
    (throw (ex-info "OpenPlanner event disappeared during metadata repair"
                    {:status 503
                     :code "openplanner_event_missing"
                     :event-id event-id})))
  (let [extra (:extra row)
        conflicts (into {}
                        (keep (fn [[key expected]]
                                (let [actual (get extra key)]
                                  (when (and (some? actual)
                                             (not= expected actual))
                                    [key {:expected expected
                                          :actual actual}]))))
                        required-extra)]
    (when (seq conflicts)
      (throw (ex-info "OpenPlanner event metadata conflicts with immutable translation evidence"
                      {:status 409
                       :code "openplanner_event_extra_conflict"
                       :event-id event-id
                       :conflicts conflicts})))
    {:extra extra
     :missing (into {}
                    (filter (fn [[key _expected]] (nil? (get extra key))))
                    required-extra)}))

(defn- dotted-extra-set
  [fields]
  (into {} (map (fn [[key value]] [(str "extra." (name key)) value])) fields))

(defn- missing-field-guard
  [[key expected]]
  (let [path (str "extra." (name key))]
    {:$or [{path {:$exists false}}
           {path nil}
           {path expected}]}))

(defn- ^:async write-missing-extra!
  [^js events event-id extra missing]
  (if (map? extra)
    (await (.updateOne events
                       (clj->js {:id event-id
                                 :$and (mapv missing-field-guard missing)})
                       (clj->js {:$set (dotted-extra-set missing)})))
    (await (.updateOne events
                       (clj->js {:id event-id
                                 :$or [{:extra nil}
                                       {:extra {:$exists false}}]})
                       (clj->js {:$set {:extra missing}})))))

(defn ^:async ensure-event-extra-fields!
  "Backfill deterministic missing fields on one stable existing event.

  A conflicting non-nil value is immutable evidence drift and is refused. The
  guarded update fills only absent/nil fields, then re-reads the row so a lost
  race or an adapter that ignored the update still fails closed."
  [event-id required-extra]
  (when-not (map? required-extra)
    (throw (ex-info "OpenPlanner event extra repair requires a field map"
                    {:status 500 :code "openplanner_event_extra_invalid"})))
  (let [sdk (await (get-sdk!))
        events (events-collection! sdk event-id)
        before (extra-state! event-id (await (event-row! events event-id))
                             required-extra)]
    (when (seq (:missing before))
      (await (write-missing-extra! events event-id (:extra before)
                                   (:missing before))))
    (let [after (extra-state! event-id (await (event-row! events event-id))
                              required-extra)]
      (when (seq (:missing after))
        (throw (ex-info "OpenPlanner event metadata repair was not persisted"
                        {:status 503
                         :code "openplanner_event_extra_repair_failed"
                         :event-id event-id
                         :missing-fields (vec (keys (:missing after)))})))
      {:ok true
       :event-id event-id
       :updated-fields (vec (keys (:missing before)))})))

(defn- ^:async raw-event-rows!
  [^js events ids]
  (let [cursor (.find events
                      (clj->js {:id {:$in ids}})
                      (clj->js
                       {:projection {:id 1 :ts 1 :source 1 :kind 1
                                     :project 1 :session 1 :message 1
                                     :role 1 :author 1 :model 1 :text 1
                                     :extra 1}}))]
    (await (.toArray cursor))))

(defn- raw-events-in-id-order!
  [ids raw-rows]
  (let [by-id (into {} (map (fn [^js row] [(aget row "id") row]))
                    (array-seq raw-rows))
        missing (filterv #(nil? (get by-id %)) ids)]
    (when (seq missing)
      (throw (ex-info "OpenPlanner base event is missing during vector repair"
                      {:status 503
                       :code "openplanner_event_missing"
                       :missing-event-ids missing})))
    (mapv by-id ids)))

(defn- unindexable-event-reason
  [^js event]
  (let [text (aget event "text")
        kind (aget event "kind")]
    (cond
      (not (string? text)) :text-not-string
      (empty? (.trim text)) :blank-text
      (contains? #{"graph.node" "graph.edge"} kind) :excluded-kind
      (not (sdk-mod/shouldIndexEventHotVectors event)) :sdk-declined
      :else nil)))

(defn- raw-event-labels
  [^js extra]
  (let [labels (some-> extra (aget "openplanner_labels") (aget "labels"))]
    (if (js/Array.isArray labels)
      (->> (array-seq labels)
           (map #(-> (or % "") str .trim))
           (remove empty?)
           distinct
           clj->js)
      #js [])))

(defn- nullish-default
  [value fallback]
  (if (nil? value) fallback value))

(defn- embedding-scope
  [^js event]
  (let [scope #js {:source (aget event "source")
                   :kind (aget event "kind")}
        project (aget event "project")]
    (when-not (nil? project)
      (aset scope "project" project))
    scope))

(defn- index-metadata
  [^js event ^js extra embedding-model]
  (let [labels-root (some-> extra (aget "openplanner_labels"))]
    #js {:ts (aget event "ts")
         :source (aget event "source")
         :kind (aget event "kind")
         :project (aget event "project")
         :session (aget event "session")
         :author (nullish-default (aget event "author") "")
         :role (nullish-default (aget event "role") "")
         :model (nullish-default (aget event "model") "")
         :embedding_model (nullish-default embedding-model "")
         :search_tier "hot"
         :visibility (nullish-default (some-> extra (aget "visibility"))
                                      "internal")
         :quality_label (nullish-default
                         (some-> labels-root (aget "quality")) "")
         :labels (raw-event-labels extra)
         :title (nullish-default
                 (some-> extra (aget "title"))
                 (nullish-default (aget event "message")
                                  (aget event "id")))}))

(defn- assert-indexable-event!
  [^js event]
  (when-let [reason (unindexable-event-reason event)]
    (throw (ex-info "OpenPlanner base event cannot produce a hot vector"
                    {:status 422
                     :code "openplanner_event_not_vector_indexable"
                     :event-id (aget event "id")
                     :kind (aget event "kind")
                     :reason reason}))))

(defn- ^:async index-event-vector!
  [^js sdk ^js event]
  (assert-indexable-event! event)
  (let [scope (embedding-scope event)
        hot (some-> sdk (.-embeddingRuntime) (.-hot))
        extra (or (aget event "extra") #js {})
        embedding-model (.getModel hot scope)
        embedding-function (.getBackgroundEmbeddingFunction hot scope)]
    (try
      (await
       (mongo-vectors/indexTextInMongoVectors
        #js {:mongo (.-mongo sdk)
             :tier "hot"
             :parentId (aget event "id")
             :text (aget event "text")
             :extra extra
             :metadata (index-metadata event extra embedding-model)
             :embeddingFunction embedding-function}))
      (catch :default err
        (throw (ex-info "OpenPlanner event vector repair failed"
                        {:status 503
                         :code "openplanner_event_vector_repair_failed"
                         :event-id (aget event "id")
                         :detail (or (.-message err) (str err))}
                        err))))))

(defn- ^:async repair-event-vectors!
  [^js sdk raw-events]
  (loop [remaining raw-events]
    (when-let [event (first remaining)]
      (await (index-event-vector! sdk event))
      (recur (next remaining)))))

(defn- ^:async ensure-event-vectors-with-sdk!
  [^js sdk event-ids]
  (let [ids (checked-event-ids! event-ids)]
    (if (empty? ids)
      {:ok true :event-ids [] :event-count 0 :vector-count 0
       :repaired-event-ids []}
      (let [dimensions (configured-embedding-dimensions!)
            rows (await (hot-vector-rows! sdk ids))
            coverage (vector-coverage ids dimensions rows)
            repair-set (set (concat (:missing-event-ids coverage)
                                    (:invalid-event-ids coverage)))
            repair-ids (filterv repair-set ids)]
        (when (seq repair-ids)
          (let [events (events-collection! sdk (first repair-ids))
                raw-rows (await (raw-event-rows! events repair-ids))]
            (await (repair-event-vectors!
                    sdk (raw-events-in-id-order! repair-ids raw-rows)))))
        (assoc (await (verify-event-vectors-with-sdk! sdk ids))
               :repaired-event-ids repair-ids)))))

(defn ^:async ensure-event-vectors!
  "Materialize missing/invalid hot vectors from immutable base event rows.

  No base event is reinserted. Re-indexing uses the SDK's current scoped model,
  background embedding function, event metadata rules and transactional vector
  replacement, then performs the same strict dimensional verification as an
  awaited ingest. Blank text and SDK-excluded event kinds fail explicitly."
  [event-ids]
  (let [sdk (await (get-sdk!))]
    (await (ensure-event-vectors-with-sdk! sdk event-ids))))

(defn ^:async events!
  "Ingest event envelopes. Same response shape as POST /v1/events.

  Embedded callers that need read-your-writes may pass
  `{:await-index? true}`. This awaits the SDK's detached embedding work before
  removing its transport-only promise from the returned response."
  ([events]
   (await (events! events {})))
  ([events {:keys [await-index?]}]
   (let [sdk (await (get-sdk!))
         result (await (.ingestEvents sdk (clj->js events)))
         background-indexing (aget result "backgroundIndexing")]
     (when (and await-index? background-indexing)
       (await background-indexing))
     (when await-index?
       (await (ensure-event-vectors-with-sdk! sdk (mapv :id events))))
     (js-delete result "acceptedEvents")
     (js-delete result "backgroundIndexing")
     (xjson/to-cljs result))))

(defn ^:async vector-search!
  "Vector search. Same response shape as POST /v1/search/vector."
  [payload]
  (let [sdk (await (get-sdk!))]
    (xjson/to-cljs (await (.searchVector sdk (clj->js payload))))))

(defn ^:async session
  "Session detail. Same response shape as GET /v1/sessions/:id."
  [session-id opts]
  (let [sdk (await (get-sdk!))]
    (xjson/to-cljs (await (sdk-mod/getSessionResponse (mongo-ctx sdk) (str session-id) (clj->js (or opts {})))))))

(defn ^:async sessions
  "Session list. Same response shape as GET /v1/sessions."
  [opts]
  (let [sdk (await (get-sdk!))]
    (xjson/to-cljs (await (sdk-mod/listSessionsResponse (mongo-ctx sdk) (clj->js (or opts {})))))))

(defn ^:async mongo-collections
  "Collection inventory. Same response shape as GET /v1/mongo/collections."
  []
  (let [sdk (await (get-sdk!))]
    (xjson/to-cljs (await (sdk-mod/listCollectionsResponse (mongo-ctx sdk))))))

(defn ^:async mongo-query
  "Raw collection query. Same response shape as POST /v1/mongo/query."
  [payload]
  (let [sdk (await (get-sdk!))]
    (xjson/to-cljs (await (sdk-mod/queryCollectionResponse (mongo-ctx sdk) (clj->js (or payload {})))))))

(defn ^:async health
  "Mongo-mode health probe shaped like the REST client's health! result:
   {:ok bool :status int :body map}."
  []
  (try
    (let [sdk (await (get-sdk!))
          db (.-db (.-mongo sdk))]
      (await (.command (.admin db) #js {:ping 1}))
      {:ok true
       :status 200
       :body {:ok true :storageBackend "mongodb" :transport "sdk"}})
    (catch :default err
      {:ok false
       :status 503
       :body {:detail (str "OpenPlanner SDK mongo ping failed: " (.-message err))}})))

name: knoxx-ci

on:
  pull_request:
    # Infrastructure admission depends on the current PR body.
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, edited]
    branches:
      - main
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

env:
  # ubuntu runners ship a snap-wrapper /usr/bin/chromium-browser that hangs
  # under CI; point puppeteer-core at the real Chrome binary instead.
  PUPPETEER_EXECUTABLE_PATH: /usr/bin/google-chrome
  # Knoxx uses the existing OpenPlanner SDK for the non-translation data plane.
  # Translation storage is Knoxx-owned ClojureScript and has no companion PR.
  # Exact personal source candidate. Its synchronization parent and recall PR
  # remain independent qualification gates; a pin is not deployment approval.
  OPENPLANNER_REF: 137ba891a8d119716cfa603c6a3643d07acc30c3

jobs:
  deployment-boundary:
    name: deployment-boundary
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Knoxx
        uses: actions/checkout@v5
      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v5
        with:
          node-version: 22
      - name: Reject retired deployment authority
        run: |
          node scripts/check-deployment-boundary.mjs --self-test
          node scripts/check-deployment-boundary.mjs

  knoxx:
    name: knoxx (backend + frontend)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 45

    services:
      mongodb:
        # Policy bootstrap performs transactions and intentionally refuses a
        # standalone mongod. Atlas Local supplies the same single-node replica
        # topology used by `pnpm local:up`, so the browser gate exercises the
        # production persistence contract instead of dying before HTTP bind.
        image: mongodb/mongodb-atlas-local@sha256:5941a11ca0fa4f4ed7ffc6c476253f95449cd96797fbf66a2deade10f54e0cd5
        ports:
          - 27017:27017

    steps:
      - name: Checkout Knoxx
        uses: actions/checkout@v5
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Checkout OpenPlanner SDK source
        uses: actions/checkout@v5
        with:
          repository: riatzukiza/openplanner
          ref: ${{ env.OPENPLANNER_REF }}
          path: _deps/openplanner
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Setup Java (required by shadow-cljs / Closure Compiler)
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          # Closure Compiler artifacts used by shadow-cljs now require Java 21
          # (class file version 65).
          java-version: "21"

      - name: Setup Clojure CLI
        uses: DeLaGuardo/setup-clojure@13
        with:
          # backend/shadow-cljs.edn runs in :deps mode, so shadow-cljs resolves
          # its classpath (including the katamorph Git dependency) through
          # tools.deps and needs the clojure CLI on PATH.
          cli: latest
          clj-kondo: latest

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          # OpenPlanner's current lockfile/override projection is generated by
          # pnpm 10; pnpm 9 reports a false frozen-lockfile mismatch.
          version: 10.20.0

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v5
        with:
          # agent-browser's native launcher requires Node 24.
          node-version: 24
          cache: pnpm
          cache-dependency-path: |
            pnpm-lock.yaml
            backend/pnpm-lock.yaml
            frontend/pnpm-lock.yaml
            _deps/openplanner/pnpm-lock.yaml

      - name: Build linked OpenPlanner SDK and scoped graph recall
        run: |
          # Knoxx currently resolves this linked source through a sibling path:
          # backend/package.json -> ../../openplanner/packages/openplanner-sdk
          ln -sfn "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/_deps/openplanner" "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/../openplanner"
          pnpm -C _deps/openplanner --filter @open-hax/openplanner-sdk... --filter @open-hax/openplanner-graph-claim-core... install --frozen-lockfile
          pnpm -C _deps/openplanner --filter @open-hax/openplanner-sdk... --filter @open-hax/openplanner-graph-claim-core... run build

      - name: Install Knoxx packages
        run: |
          pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
          pnpm -C backend install --frozen-lockfile
          pnpm -C frontend install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Shared markup lint
        run: pnpm -C backend run lint:shared-markup

      - name: Backend typecheck (shadow-cljs compile app)
        run: pnpm -C backend run typecheck

      # Verify the browser against the backend artifact immediately after the
      # compile that produces it. Keeping this isolated from later coverage and
      # e2e processes makes the required visual contract deterministic and
      # lets browser regressions fail fast without weakening the job: every
      # remaining suite below must still pass before this required check does.
      - name: Translation review browser contract
        env:
          MONGODB_URI: mongodb://127.0.0.1:27017/knoxx_translation_browser_ci?directConnection=true
          MONGODB_DB: knoxx_translation_browser_ci
          KNOXX_SHOT_DIR: ${{ runner.temp }}/knoxx-translation-browser
          KNOXX_PUBLICATION_CONTENT_ROOT: ${{ runner.temp }}/knoxx-publication-content
        run: ./scripts/verify-translation-browser-ci.sh

      - name: Upload translation browser storyboard
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: knoxx-translation-browser-storyboard
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/knoxx-translation-browser
          # A browser-contract failure still creates this directory and must
          # upload its evidence. An earlier setup failure has no browser
          # evidence; preserve that original failure instead of adding a
          # misleading second artifact error.
          if-no-files-found: warn

      - name: Backend tests + coverage (cljs.test via shadow-cljs + c8)
        run: pnpm -C backend run test:coverage

      # Boots a real Fastify app on an ephemeral port and drives the MCP tool
      # surface over HTTP. Hermetic — the policy context and fetch are supplied
      # by the harness — except the sandbox tools, which need a real docker
      # daemon. Runners have one, so absence is a failure here rather than a
      # silent skip: a skipped sandbox test reads exactly like a passing one.
      - name: Backend e2e (real server, MCP tool surface)
        env:
          KNOXX_E2E_REQUIRE_DOCKER: "true"
        run: pnpm -C backend run test:e2e

      - name: Upload backend coverage artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: knoxx-backend-coverage
          path: backend/coverage
          if-no-files-found: error

      - name: Backend coverage summary
        run: node --input-type=module -e "import fs from 'node:fs'; const p='backend/coverage/coverage-summary.json'; const s=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8')).total; const f=(x)=>x?.pct??0; console.log('Backend coverage — Lines:',f(s.lines),'%','Statements:',f(s.statements),'%','Functions:',f(s.functions),'%','Branches:',f(s.branches),'%');"

      - name: Frontend typecheck (tsc)
        run: pnpm -C frontend run typecheck

      - name: Frontend CLJS lint
        env:

        run: pnpm -C frontend run lint:cljs:changed

      - name: Frontend migration manifest and ratchets
        env:
          KNOXX_MIGRATION_BASE_SHA: "${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || github.event.before || 'HEAD^' }}"
        run: |
          KNOXX_MIGRATION_INFRASTRUCTURE="$(node -e '
            const fs = require("node:fs");
            const event = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(process.env.GITHUB_EVENT_PATH, "utf8"));
            const declared = (event.pull_request?.body || "").split(/\r?\n/)
              .some(line => line.trim() === "Migration infrastructure: yes");
            console.log(process.env.GITHUB_EVENT_NAME !== "pull_request" || declared);
          ')"
          export KNOXX_MIGRATION_INFRASTRUCTURE
          pnpm -C frontend run migration:check

      - name: Upload frontend migration manifest
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: knoxx-frontend-migration-manifest
          path: frontend/migration/manifest.ndedn
          if-no-files-found: error

      - name: Frontend CLJS tests
        run: pnpm -C frontend run test:cljs

      - name: Frontend production Shadow release (zero warnings)
        run: pnpm -C frontend run build:cljs

      - name: Frontend tests + coverage (vitest)
        run: pnpm -C frontend run test:coverage

      - name: Upload frontend coverage artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: knoxx-frontend-coverage
          path: frontend/coverage
          if-no-files-found: error

      - name: Coverage summary
        run: node --input-type=module -e "import fs from 'node:fs'; const p='frontend/coverage/coverage-summary.json'; const s=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8')).total; const f=(x)=>x?.pct??0; console.log('Lines:',f(s.lines),'%','Statements:',f(s.statements),'%','Functions:',f(s.functions),'%','Branches:',f(s.branches),'%');"

.github/workflows/sandbox-bundle.yml.utf8:
name: Sandbox bundle

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      include_dependency_cache:
        description: Include package-manager and JVM caches in a separate short-lived artifact
        required: false
        default: false
        type: boolean
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - "package.json"
      - "pnpm-lock.yaml"
      - "backend/**"
      - "frontend/**"
      - "ingestion/**"
      - "contracts/**"
      - "scripts/**"
      - ".github/workflows/sandbox-bundle.yml"
  push:
    branches:
      - "**"
    tags:
      - "sandbox-bundle-*"
    paths:
      - ".github/workflows/sandbox-bundle.yml"

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: sandbox-bundle-${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  bundle:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 100
    env:
      OUT: /tmp/knoxx-sandbox-export
      DEPS_OUT: /tmp/knoxx-sandbox-deps
      CLOJURE_TOOLS_VERSION: "1.12.5.1654"
      CLOJURE_TOOLS_SHA256: dc86cc56bc372fcef07bd87f44693eeb4b61cf5f44347883878364d03b5fb342
      BABASHKA_VERSION: "1.13.219"
      BABASHKA_SHA256: 9ac1fe988d7001625b30ef3e3307e67f8545505a7cb49a4aa179f578115a3e09
      CONTRACTS_DIR: ${{ github.workspace }}/contracts
      PUPPETEER_EXECUTABLE_PATH: /usr/bin/google-chrome
      OPENPLANNER_REF: 137ba891a8d119716cfa603c6a3643d07acc30c3

    steps:
      - name: Check out full repository history
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Prepare revision-bound source bundle
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          rm -rf "$OUT"
          mkdir -p "$OUT"/{source,runtime,logs,toolchain,metadata}
          repo_name="${GITHUB_REPOSITORY#*/}"
          git bundle create "$OUT/source/${repo_name}.bundle" --all
          git archive --format=tar.gz --prefix="${repo_name}/" --output="$OUT/source/source.tar.gz" HEAD
          git rev-parse HEAD > "$OUT/metadata/revision.txt"
          git status --short > "$OUT/metadata/worktree.txt"
          git submodule status --recursive > "$OUT/metadata/submodules.txt" 2>&1 || true

      - name: Check out the OpenPlanner sibling dependency
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          repository: riatzukiza/openplanner
          ref: ${{ env.OPENPLANNER_REF }}
          path: .sandbox-deps/openplanner
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Materialize Knoxx's expected sibling path
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          ln -sfn "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/.sandbox-deps/openplanner" "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/../openplanner"

      - name: Set up Java 21
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: "21"

      - name: Set up Node 22
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: "22"

      - name: Set up pnpm 10 for the pinned source lockfile
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: "10.20.0"
          run_install: false

      - name: Set up pinned Clojure CLI
        uses: DeLaGuardo/setup-clojure@13.4
        with:
          cli: ${{ env.CLOJURE_TOOLS_VERSION }}

      - name: Install root dependencies
        id: install_root
        continue-on-error: true
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          pnpm install --frozen-lockfile 2>&1 | tee "$OUT/logs/install-root.log"

      - name: Build the pinned OpenPlanner SDK and graph package
        id: build_openplanner
        if: always()
        continue-on-error: true
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          pnpm -C .sandbox-deps/openplanner --filter @open-hax/openplanner-sdk... --filter @open-hax/openplanner-graph-claim-core... install --frozen-lockfile 2>&1 | tee "$OUT/logs/install-openplanner.log"
          pnpm -C .sandbox-deps/openplanner --filter @open-hax/openplanner-sdk... --filter @open-hax/openplanner-graph-claim-core... run build 2>&1 | tee "$OUT/logs/build-openplanner.log"
          git -C .sandbox-deps/openplanner rev-parse HEAD > "$OUT/metadata/openplanner-revision.txt"

      - name: Install backend dependencies
        id: install_backend
        if: always()
        continue-on-error: true
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          pnpm -C backend install --frozen-lockfile 2>&1 | tee "$OUT/logs/install-backend.log"

      - name: Install frontend dependencies
        id: install_frontend
        if: always()
        continue-on-error: true
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          pnpm -C frontend install --frozen-lockfile 2>&1 | tee "$OUT/logs/install-frontend.log"

      - name: Run backend typecheck
        id: backend_typecheck
        if: always()
        continue-on-error: true
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          pnpm -C backend run typecheck 2>&1 | tee "$OUT/logs/backend-typecheck.log"

      - name: Run backend tests and coverage
        id: backend_tests
        if: always()
        continue-on-error: true
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          pnpm -C backend run test:coverage 2>&1 | tee "$OUT/logs/backend-tests.log"

      - name: Run frontend typecheck
        id: frontend_typecheck
        if: always()
        continue-on-error: true
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          pnpm -C frontend run typecheck 2>&1 | tee "$OUT/logs/frontend-typecheck.log"

      - name: Run frontend tests and coverage
        id: frontend_tests
        if: always()
        continue-on-error: true
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          pnpm -C frontend run test:coverage 2>&1 | tee "$OUT/logs/frontend-tests.log"

      - name: Prepare ingestion dependencies
        id: ingestion_prepare
        if: always()
        continue-on-error: true
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          (cd ingestion && clojure -P -A:test) 2>&1 | tee "$OUT/logs/ingestion-prepare.log"

      - name: Run ingestion tests
        id: ingestion_tests
        if: always()
        continue-on-error: true
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          (cd ingestion && clojure -M:test) 2>&1 | tee "$OUT/logs/ingestion-tests.log"

      - name: Collect generated outputs
        id: collect_runtime
        if: always()
        continue-on-error: true
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          paths_file="$RUNNER_TEMP/sandbox-runtime-paths"
          : > "$paths_file"
          find . -type d \( -name dist -o -name 'dist-*' -o -name target -o -name coverage -o -name reports \) \
            -not -path '*/node_modules/*' \
            -not -path '*/.git/*' \
            -not -path './.sandbox-deps/*' \
            -not -path '*/.shadow-cljs/*' \
            -print0 >> "$paths_file"
          if [[ -s "$paths_file" ]]; then
            tar --null --files-from="$paths_file" -czf "$OUT/runtime/runtime.tar.gz"
          fi

          if [[ -n "${PNPM_HOME:-}" && -d "$PNPM_HOME" ]]; then
            tar -czf "$OUT/toolchain/pnpm-home.tar.gz" -C "$(dirname "$PNPM_HOME")" "$(basename "$PNPM_HOME")"
          fi

      - name: Collect pinned Clojure CLI archive
        id: collect_clojure
        if: always()
        continue-on-error: true
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          archive="$OUT/toolchain/clojure-tools-${CLOJURE_TOOLS_VERSION}.tar.gz"
          download="$RUNNER_TEMP/clojure-tools-${CLOJURE_TOOLS_VERSION}.tar.gz"
          trap 'rm -f "$download"' EXIT
          curl -fsSL \
            "https://download.clojure.org/install/clojure-tools-${CLOJURE_TOOLS_VERSION}.tar.gz" \
            -o "$download"
          printf '%s  %s\n' "$CLOJURE_TOOLS_SHA256" "$download" | sha256sum --check --strict
          mv "$download" "$archive"

      - name: Collect pinned Babashka archive
        id: collect_babashka
        if: always()
        continue-on-error: true
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          archive="$OUT/toolchain/babashka-${BABASHKA_VERSION}-linux-amd64-static.tar.gz"
          download="$RUNNER_TEMP/babashka-${BABASHKA_VERSION}-linux-amd64-static.tar.gz"
          trap 'rm -f "$download"' EXIT
          curl -fsSL \
            "https://github.com/babashka/babashka/releases/download/v${BABASHKA_VERSION}/babashka-${BABASHKA_VERSION}-linux-amd64-static.tar.gz" \
            -o "$download"
          printf '%s  %s\n' "$BABASHKA_SHA256" "$download" | sha256sum --check --strict
          mv "$download" "$archive"

      - name: Write bundle metadata and checksums
        id: finalize_bundle
        if: always()
        env:
          INSTALL_ROOT_OUTCOME: ${{ steps.install_root.outcome }}
          BUILD_OPENPLANNER_OUTCOME: ${{ steps.build_openplanner.outcome }}
          INSTALL_BACKEND_OUTCOME: ${{ steps.install_backend.outcome }}
          INSTALL_FRONTEND_OUTCOME: ${{ steps.install_frontend.outcome }}
          BACKEND_TYPECHECK_OUTCOME: ${{ steps.backend_typecheck.outcome }}
          BACKEND_TESTS_OUTCOME: ${{ steps.backend_tests.outcome }}
          FRONTEND_TYPECHECK_OUTCOME: ${{ steps.frontend_typecheck.outcome }}
          FRONTEND_TESTS_OUTCOME: ${{ steps.frontend_tests.outcome }}
          INGESTION_PREPARE_OUTCOME: ${{ steps.ingestion_prepare.outcome }}
          INGESTION_TESTS_OUTCOME: ${{ steps.ingestion_tests.outcome }}
          RUNTIME_OUTCOME: ${{ steps.collect_runtime.outcome }}
          CLOJURE_ARCHIVE_OUTCOME: ${{ steps.collect_clojure.outcome }}
          BABASHKA_ARCHIVE_OUTCOME: ${{ steps.collect_babashka.outcome }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          for file in package.json pnpm-lock.yaml pnpm-workspace.yaml deps.edn shadow-cljs.edn; do
            [[ -f "$file" ]] && cp "$file" "$OUT/metadata/$file"
          done
          {
            node --version
            pnpm --version
            java -version
            if command -v clojure >/dev/null 2>&1; then clojure -Sdescribe || true; fi
          } > "$OUT/metadata/tool-versions.txt" 2>&1

          generated_at="$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"
          jq -n \
            --arg repository "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" \
            --arg revision "$GITHUB_SHA" \
            --arg ref "$GITHUB_REF" \
            --arg generated_at "$generated_at" \
            --arg install_root "$INSTALL_ROOT_OUTCOME" \
            --arg build_openplanner "$BUILD_OPENPLANNER_OUTCOME" \
            --arg openplanner_revision "$OPENPLANNER_REF" \
            --arg install_backend "$INSTALL_BACKEND_OUTCOME" \
            --arg install_frontend "$INSTALL_FRONTEND_OUTCOME" \
            --arg backend_typecheck "$BACKEND_TYPECHECK_OUTCOME" \
            --arg backend_tests "$BACKEND_TESTS_OUTCOME" \
            --arg frontend_typecheck "$FRONTEND_TYPECHECK_OUTCOME" \
            --arg frontend_tests "$FRONTEND_TESTS_OUTCOME" \
            --arg ingestion_prepare "$INGESTION_PREPARE_OUTCOME" \
            --arg ingestion_tests "$INGESTION_TESTS_OUTCOME" \
            --arg runtime "$RUNTIME_OUTCOME" \
            --arg clojure_archive "$CLOJURE_ARCHIVE_OUTCOME" \
            --arg babashka_archive "$BABASHKA_ARCHIVE_OUTCOME" \
            '{
              sandbox_bundle_version: 1,
              repository: $repository,
              revision: $revision,
              ref: $ref,
              generated_at: $generated_at,
              openplanner_revision: $openplanner_revision,
              outcomes: {
                install_root: $install_root,
                build_openplanner: $build_openplanner,
                install_backend: $install_backend,
                install_frontend: $install_frontend,
                backend_typecheck: $backend_typecheck,
                backend_tests: $backend_tests,
                frontend_typecheck: $frontend_typecheck,
                frontend_tests: $frontend_tests,
                ingestion_prepare: $ingestion_prepare,
                ingestion_tests: $ingestion_tests,
                runtime_collection: $runtime,
                clojure_archive: $clojure_archive,
                babashka_archive: $babashka_archive
              },
              setup_commands: [
                "pnpm install --frozen-lockfile",
                "pnpm -C backend install --frozen-lockfile",
                "pnpm -C frontend install --frozen-lockfile",
                "cd ingestion && clojure -P -A:test"
              ],
              validation_commands: [
                "pnpm -C backend run typecheck",
                "pnpm -C backend run test:coverage",
                "pnpm -C frontend run typecheck",
                "pnpm -C frontend run test:coverage",
                "cd ingestion && clojure -M:test"
              ],
              network_required_after_restore: true
            }' > "$OUT/manifest.json"
          checksum_file="$(mktemp "$RUNNER_TEMP/sandbox-source-checksums.XXXXXXXX")"
          trap 'rm -f "$checksum_file"' EXIT
          (cd "$OUT" && find . -type f ! -name SHA256SUMS -print0 | sort -z | xargs -0 sha256sum) > "$checksum_file"
          mv "$checksum_file" "$OUT/SHA256SUMS"

      - name: Package optional dependency cache
        if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.include_dependency_cache
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          rm -rf "$DEPS_OUT"
          mkdir -p "$DEPS_OUT"
          store="$(pnpm store path 2>/dev/null || true)"
          if [[ -n "$store" && -d "$store" ]]; then
            tar -czf "$DEPS_OUT/pnpm-store.tar.gz" -C "$(dirname "$store")" "$(basename "$store")"
          fi
          if [[ -d "$HOME/.m2/repository" ]]; then
            tar -czf "$DEPS_OUT/m2-repository.tar.gz" -C "$HOME/.m2" repository
          fi
          if [[ -d "$HOME/.gitlibs" ]]; then
            tar -czf "$DEPS_OUT/gitlibs.tar.gz" -C "$HOME" .gitlibs
          fi
          checksum_file="$(mktemp "$RUNNER_TEMP/sandbox-deps-checksums.XXXXXXXX")"
          trap 'rm -f "$checksum_file"' EXIT
          (cd "$DEPS_OUT" && find . -type f ! -name SHA256SUMS -print0 | sort -z | xargs -0 sha256sum) > "$checksum_file"
          mv "$checksum_file" "$DEPS_OUT/SHA256SUMS"

      - name: Upload sandbox bundle
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: knoxx-sandbox-${{ github.sha }}
          path: ${{ env.OUT }}
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 30

      - name: Upload optional dependency cache
        if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.include_dependency_cache
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: knoxx-sandbox-deps-${{ github.sha }}
          path: ${{ env.DEPS_OUT }}
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7

      - name: Preserve collection and validation result
        if: >-
          always() &&
          (steps.install_root.outcome == 'failure' ||
           steps.build_openplanner.outcome == 'failure' ||
           steps.install_backend.outcome == 'failure' ||
           steps.install_frontend.outcome == 'failure' ||
           steps.backend_typecheck.outcome == 'failure' ||
           steps.backend_tests.outcome == 'failure' ||
           steps.frontend_typecheck.outcome == 'failure' ||
           steps.frontend_tests.outcome == 'failure' ||
           steps.ingestion_prepare.outcome == 'failure' ||
           steps.ingestion_tests.outcome == 'failure' ||
           steps.collect_runtime.outcome == 'failure' ||
           steps.collect_clojure.outcome == 'failure' ||
           steps.collect_babashka.outcome == 'failure' ||
           steps.finalize_bundle.outcome == 'failure')
        shell: bash
        run: exit 1

# Local creator loop: proposal and human verification

License: GPL-3.0-or-later.

This change gives the existing OpenHax character a small capability interface
over its authorized social and memory tools. External encounters must be
retained in the existing scoped event store and supplied to later turns so that
attention and creative choices can respond to the world. A successful post, a
different prompt, or a different random seed does not establish that behavior.

**Status:** proposed local deployment change; not applied to the host overlay.
The supported SDK remains the execution engine. Replacing it with the Turn
Processor is conditional on an actual blocker; none was established for
discovery, delegated argument validation, or conversation continuity.

## What is observed, proposed, and still required

Read-only inspection on October 7, 2026 found the local backend using an
image-owned compiled server and a read-only host contract mount. The image's
revision label identifies the base checkout, not uncommitted feature code.
The creative schedule is every fifteen minutes. Its trigger says to make a
saved artifact every cycle, inspect the previous project, and avoid beginning
with a Discord or web search. The maker's allowlist admits its own Bluesky
feed/profile/publication and Discord sending, but excludes most perception and
memory tools. The conversational head separately prioritizes quick replies and
does not interrupt the maker.

These are deployment facts, not proof of the complete cause of repetitive
outputs. Earlier runtime records showed repeated self summaries, empty memory
hydration, and no social perception calls in the sampled completed cycles.
Those observations support the need for an independent perception path and
meaningful recall; they do not establish that every historical cycle lacked
external information.

The source implementation now connects scheduled `:actions/character-intake`
to existing authorized social read closures and OpenPlanner event ports. Maker
and reply turns reload bounded admitted encounters before assembling their
decision input. Fixture coverage checks retry, refreshed authority, and
reconstructing ports over retained rows. **The host overlay has not been
changed: consumed source settings and fixtures do not establish deployed
intake, natural decisions, or a complete continuous creator personality.**

## Reviewable deployment delta

The proposed values are in
[local-creator-loop-proposed/replacement-values.edn](local-creator-loop-proposed/replacement-values.edn).
This file is a review aid, not a resource loaded by Knoxx and not a new merge
protocol. Apply the individual values manually to the existing host-owned
resources only after the activation prerequisites below are met. Preserve
resource identities and validate the final resources using Knoxx's existing
resource validator.

| Existing resource or value | Proposed behavior | Preserved obligations |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Creative trigger's `:trigger/with :task` | Each tick is an opportunity to observe, reflect, converse, develop work, publish eligible work, or take no public action. A decision should cite admitted encounter or memory evidence when available. | Existing fifteen-minute opportunity cadence; explicit creative requests; truthful files and tool receipts; no retry loops or extra recurring jobs. |
| First maker system-prompt paragraph | Remove the mandatory-artifact requirement. Retain the existing OpenHax identity, voice, role prompts, file organization, and operational guidance. | No new persona, model, credentials, Discord permission changes, or runtime cancellation. |
| `:agent :tool-modes` | A stable `capabilities` / `invoke` interface reveals one focused group. The underlying registry retains broad tools already admitted by current authority. | Contract allowlist is a ceiling; current stored actor grants, resource policy, credentials, and active mode are checked again before actual execution. |
| Existing context source references | Preserve all existing references and add the existing OpenPlanner memory context source if it is absent. | Sources merge by existing source identity. Read filters and publication sinks remain distinct. |
| `:agent :character-encounters` plus scheduled intake action | Existing source adapters fetch external material independently of model tool selection and pass bounded normalized pages to the shared admission port. | Original timestamps, owner/account/scope, causal source identity, bounded cursor/coverage evidence, emoji, reactions, and media references survive. Oversized optional media labels are omitted; exact identities are never shortened. No vision claim follows from a URL or attachment. |
| Conversational head | Remain promptly present in the two home channels; use the supplied incoming event before seeking more context. Add only underlying canonical source reads and bounded scoped recall, with a separate small mode map. | Reply-to identity, ordinary single-send behavior, no ordinary Bluesky publication, no maker production tools, maker independence, and current stored grants remain in force. |

The mode configuration contains only real registered canonical tool IDs. A
group containing an unavailable or unauthorized capability is refused rather
than silently broadening permissions or presenting a partly valid group. The
operator must compare the proposal with the resolved registry before activation
and select the groups that current authority can admit. Additional permitted
Discord APIs, voice, direct messages, or later source adapters can be grouped
through the same mechanism when their supported closures and grants exist.
This proposal does not claim that every Discord API is implemented.

Read-only deployment preflight also found that the current stored actor
membership has only its Discord user role and nineteen tool grants. Those
grants cover the initial home Discord tools, canonical channel-message reads
and scoped memory search/session tools. They do not currently grant Bluesky,
workspace creation tools, media tools or agent delegation. The refreshed
authority intersection correctly refuses those capabilities; resource-shape
validation and an expanded contract ceiling cannot grant them.

Activation therefore also needs a reviewed, actor-specific membership override
delta through the existing supported policy operations, with its exact prior
state retained for rollback. The separately prepared operator artifact carries
the minimum explicit canonical tool IDs needed by the selected maker/reply
groups and Bluesky intake. It must not add global roles, administrator access,
wildcards or new platform/channel scopes. No stored grant has been changed by
this work. Bluesky intake and production/delegation modes are not currently
admitted on the live actor; the permission delta shares the explicit cutover
approval gate with the image and host resources.

The source also repairs the existing member-policy compatibility boundary:
fresh membership hydration retains its stored overrides in the canonical
authority field and the unchanged API alias. The supported policy update route
uses the existing organization codec, so an operator with the required policy
permission in the selected organization can apply the exact delta. Cross-org
and missing-permission requests remain refused; the bot receives no operator
or administrator role. Injected-port fixtures exercise the actual hydrator,
request context, focused clamp and registered update handler without a write.

Native argument validation uses the trusted Malli schema attached to the
closure. Most existing social argument maps allow additional fields; closed
